plain: A ruler with absolute power, who often rules cruelly

webster.text: An emperor, king or prince invested with absolute power, or ruling without any control from men, constitution or laws.

example.quote: It is certainly right and fit, that the governors of every people should provide for the common defence and general welfare; every government, therefore, in the world, even the greatest despot, is limited in the exercise of his power.
example.cite: Brutus VI, New York Journal, Dec. 27, 1787
